Chapter 1433 - 10: Summoning The Future Self_2

Chapter 1433 - 10: Summoning the Future Self_2

...

Rumble——

Endless darkness surged, coalescing into three figures.

These three figures were vague and shrouded in darkness, making them indistinguishable.

"Tianshi, you've come this far too." The leading dark figure stared at the Lord Tianshi for a while and then shook its head, saying, "In that case, you can leave now."

Given the strength that the Lord Tianshi displayed at this moment, the three of them were not confident enough to keep him, unless they used their trump cards, which were reserved for the real Legendary Lords.

Naturally, they were unwilling to use them on the Lord Tianshi.

"Leave?"

The Lord Tianshi sneered, "You three, sneaky and wasting my time, hand over ten million pounds of the Sand of Time each, and I'll consider leaving."

"Tianshi, you're going too far."

The leading dark figure's tone was low.

The eyes of the two dark figures behind it also looked unpleasant.

Since entering the Wanwei dimension, they had always been the ones plundering other lords; when had they ever been plundered?

Hand over ten million pounds of the Sand of Time?

"Don't hand it over? Then let me see who you really are."

The Lord Tianshi stepped forward, a terrifying aura sweeping across. His curved horns emitted a distorted wave, continuously penetrating and engulfing the dark forces around.

Bang!

Two distinctly different forces collided.

Everything in all directions was being destroyed, causing even the many Time Lords watching the battle to retreat a big step back.

"A confrontation between Second Layer extreme lords, it's too rare."

"Indeed, even in this Wanwei dimension, such level of slaughter doesn't occur every time it opens."

Many Time Lords were thrilled, and they began to call friends, more Time Lords rushing towards this location.

Every opening of the Wanwei dimension attracts some truly powerful Time Lords, but even if these lords meet, they may not necessarily engage in slaughter.

It was only because the Lord Tianshi was infuriated by the three dark figures. He had deliberately hidden his strength, and even when fighting more than ten other lords, he didn't go all out, just to reveal it at a crucial moment.

It was because the three dark figures exposed themselves prematurely.

Buzz buzz buzz~ As the fight continued, the three figures no longer held back their attacks, unleashing their true power.

The leading dark figure released a crimson aura, its hidden form becoming clear, with bright red hair, and an oppressive presence like muddy ground.

The other two figures, one was covered in scales, the other appeared ethereal.

The three figures were all extremely terrifying in power, and before they went all out, the Lord Tianshi could still stand his ground against the three, occasionally even gaining the upper hand.

But once the three figures went all out, the Lord Tianshi immediately fell into a disadvantage, forced to defend.

...

"So it's them."

With the three dark figures revealing their true strength, their identities could no longer be hidden.

To reach the lord level, one must have journeyed through ages and explored numerous relics; it's impossible for them to have no information leaked out.

Even if their true origins couldn't be known, the methods they had used certainly had some records.

"It's the Blood Sea Lord, Void Spirit Lord, and Lord of Armor!"

Each lord had a serious expression.

Among the three Time Lords, the Blood Sea Lord was the strongest, universally acknowledged as having Second Layer extreme power, while the other two were slightly weaker but still in the last few trials of the billion and eight thousand tribulations.

The Blood Sea Lord... is said to have emerged from an endless sea of blood, born when a top-dimensional space was destroyed by an external force, causing all beings inside to fall.

From birth, the Blood Sea Lord possessed twelfth level full power, and later easily passed the test of time cycles, gradually becoming a Time Lord, reaching Second Layer extreme power.

The other two lords, Void Spirit Lord and Lord of Armor, belonged to different dimensional crevice life forms, and the three of them had been adventuring together since their weaker days.

"Didn't expect it to be these three fiends."

Many Time Lords were silently alarmed; over endless ages, the Blood Sea Lord and the other two lords had ambushed numerous other lords, and even massacred Time Lifeforms on a large scale, making them notorious among the lords.

"I figured it was you all along."

The Lord Tianshi was not surprised. There were so many Time Lords, three together? And setting traps specifically to lure other lords in to threaten and kill them?

Under such restricted conditions, not many Time Lords fit.

"So what if you figured it out?"

The Blood Sea Lord was indifferent. Their reputation was already notorious; otherwise, they wouldn't need to hide their identities to enter Wanwei Space-Time.

Hiding their identities, even in front of the Time Lords who fell into the trap, was mainly because the three of them had too many enemies and a bad reputation.

If they revealed their identities, some Time Lords might fight to the death without surrendering the Sands of Time.

Crash—

The blood sea roared, revealing the true capabilities of the Blood Sea Lord. With the help of the other two lords, they began to suppress the Tianshi Lord.

"It's useless."

"The three of you are teaming up, and with this dark weapon, you can indeed suppress me, but to crush me? It's not achievable in a short time."

The Tianshi Lord had switched from offense to defense, with a pair of twisted gray horns above his head forming an invisible barrier to resist the attacks from the Blood Sea Lord and the other two lords.

"You're stalling?"

The Blood Sea Lord immediately sensed the Tianshi Lord's intention.

"Correct."

The Tianshi Lord nodded, "I've already called some friends over. The three of you, it seems, will have a difficult time leaving Wanwei Space-Time this time."

Many Time Lords have enmity with the Blood Sea Lord and the other two lords, both direct and indirect hatred.

"Troublesome indeed."

The Blood Sea Lord, upon hearing this, furrowed his brow.

The three of them had tried to leave, but the Tianshi Lord chose to entangle them.

"Big brother."

The ethereal Void Spirit Lord looked at the Blood Sea Lord.

If the news of the three of them appearing in Wanwei Space-Time spread and they didn't leave in time, more and more Time Lords were likely to gather.

The Time Lords who had grudges with them would very likely take action.

To be enemies with many Time Lords? The Blood Sea Lord and the other two Time Lords temporarily did not have the confidence for this.

And as time passes, it might even attract the attention of a Legendary Lord.

If any Legendary Lord had opinions about them and took action, that would be troublesome.

Most Time Lords preferred peace, like Lord Wanwei, who opened up Wanwei Space-Time specifically before a failed breakthrough for future Time Lords.

"I understand."

The Blood Sea Lord nodded.

They entered Wanwei Space-Time carrying a powerful weapon; if they were truly left behind, the loss would naturally be great.

"Tianshi, this move, I originally intended to reserve it for the Legendary Lords."

The Blood Sea Lord overlooked the Tianshi Lord, speaking calmly.

Before entering Wanwei Space-Time, he had prepared for the worst.

Even facing a Legendary Lord, there was hope of resistance and struggle to retreat.

It was just unexpected that this trump card was used on the Tianshi Lord.

"Reserved for the Legendary Lords?"

The Tianshi Lord was slightly taken aback, sneering, "Are you worthy?"

Lords of the Second Layer had little capability to resist in front of a Legendary Lord.

"The future....."

The Blood Sea Lord didn't say much, his mind soaring unbounded, feeling the space-time of distant time segments.

In three hundred and sixty-two great cataclysm cycles, he would become a Legendary Lord, a fact that was already confirmed.

Feeling the future space-time, calling upon his future self as a Legendary Lord to lend aid in the current space-time, was the Blood Sea Lord's greatest final trump card.

Whoosh—

An invisible aura spread, the timeline began to blur, and faintly, behind the Blood Sea Lord, an endless blood sea loomed.

"What is this?"

The Tianshi Lord's brow twitched, staring at the Blood Sea Lord, "Are you summoning your future self?"

Summoning one's future self was a technique most Time Lords could use, though it wasn't very significant.

Most Time Lords would not experience significant transformation in the future timeline they could perceive.

"Summoning the future self?" Lin Yuan, watching from afar, also felt stirred, carefully sensing the changes in the current timeline.

He was not yet a true Time Lord, and this was the first time he witnessed such a method of summoning a future self.
